arabic text: Husainiyat ki baqaa hai, hussain ka asghar
english translation text: Asghar is the survival of Hussainiyat

arabic text: Guroor karti thi jis hurmala pe fawje yazid \nUsi pe ran me hasaa hai, hussain ka asghar
english translation text: Yazid's army took pride in Hurmala \nYet Hussain's Asghar smiled at him in the battlefield

arabic text: Jo maangna hai to jhule, ki sumt aa jaao \nAmir-e karbobala hain, hussain ka asghar
english translation text: Whatever you seek, come towards the cradle \nHussain's Asghar is the prince of Karbala

arabic text: Kabhi shawoor ki aankhon, se par kitaab-e atash \nVarak varak pe likhaa hain, hussain ka asghar
english translation text: Read the book of thirst with the eyes of understanding \nUpon every page is written: Hussain's Asghar

arabic text: Qadam uthaa nahi paaya, magar yazid tere \nQadam ukhaar gaya hai, hussain ka asghar
english translation text: He could not even take a step, yet, O Yazid \nHussain's Asghar uprooted your foundations

arabic text: Bilal ab meri kaamat ko kon naapega \nMeri jabeen pe likhaa hain hussain ka asghar
english translation text: "Bilal", who can now measure the height of my stature? \nUpon my forehead is written: Hussain's Asghar
